If q>0, sigma_q>tau; every nonnegative k<q then has sigma_(k+1)>=sigma_q>tau and is not admissible.
If q=0, sigma_1<=tau, so index zero is admissible and there is no smaller nonnegative index. No sigma_0 is evaluated.
